scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-18 UTC inspected fresh main, recent batches, repository instructions, schemas, diagnostic standard, task claims, existing profiles, validators, tests and CI. Existing isolated worktree reused under using-git-worktrees; unrelated local image work and the prior blocked Botrytis draft were preserved and excluded. All 68 final local commands passed: 62 validators, 292 application tests, 103 Python tests, type check, build, artifact verification and diff check; five supplemental evaluator/artifact self-tests passed. JSON/JSONL syntax, source identity, duplicate, label, source-claim, CSV/export and candidate-leakage gates passed. Serial freezes matched actual input provenance and synchronized 191-row text artifact pins without model training. Historical URLs were not all independently revalidated. PHP is unavailable locally; exact-head hosted workflows including PHP lint are required before integration. Verification-before-completion gates publication. Operational claim is excluded from publication and released after merge. No production deployment. Remaining gaps include cultivar-diverse laboratory-linked root images, paired canopy/root/soil evidence, field injury thresholds and longitudinal diagnostic video. Image-only abundance, symptom-only infection, species/race from galls, and causal labels without linked tests remain restricted for human review. Agent review is not actual human, expert or laboratory specimen confirmation.
